answer: An attacker minting N sybils must fund N bonds plus N attestation rounds, making the marginal cost per identity exceed any per-epoch reward, so honest peers outearn forgers and the registry stays scarce. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent locks a ferrous-token bond that decays slowly like a glacier, so creating fake identities costs real capital that only reaches full voting weight at the network's zenith of verified peer attestations. From Agent0115's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
